argument.root_pretty:
∀ {S : Type uS} {A : Type uA} {Y : Type uY} [Nonempty A] (K : AuditCP.AuditChannel S A Y),
  AuditCP.BlackwellEquivalent (AuditCP.learnerExperiment K) AuditCP.publicOnlyExperiment ↔ AuditCP.AuditSealed K

leaves.doc:
B6 — `AuditChannel S A Y` is `AuditExperiment (S × A) Y`, an experiment whose parameter is
split into a public coordinate `S` and an audit coordinate `A`.
leaves.pretty: AuditCP.AuditIndex → AuditCP.AuditIndex → AuditCP.AuditIndex → Type (max u v w)

leaves.doc:
B5 — `AuditExperiment Θ X` is the type of parameter-indexed discrete observation laws
`Θ → PMF X`.

The channel `K` is audit-sealed: its output law at fixed public state `s` does not depend on
the audit state `a`.
leaves.pretty: {S : Type uS} → {A : Type uA} → {Y : Type uY} → AuditCP.AuditChannel S A Y → Prop

leaves.doc:
`E₀` is Blackwell-below `E₁` when some garbling `G` of `E₁`'s output reproduces `E₀`:
`∃ G, ∀ θ, E₀ θ = (E₁ θ).bind G` (blackwell1953).
leaves.pretty: {Θ : Type uΘ} → {X₀ : Type uX₀} → {X₁ : Type uX₁} → AuditCP.AuditExperiment Θ X₀ → AuditCP.AuditExperiment Θ X₁ → Prop

leaves.doc: `E₀` and `E₁` are Blackwell-equivalent when each is Blackwell-below the other (blackwell1953).
leaves.pretty: {Θ : Type uΘ} → {X₀ : Type uX₀} → {X₁ : Type uX₁} → AuditCP.AuditExperiment Θ X₀ → AuditCP.AuditExperiment Θ X₁ → Prop

leaves.doc: The channel `K` factors through the public coordinate: `∃ H, ∀ s a, K (s, a) = H s`.
leaves.pretty: {S : Type uS} → {A : Type uA} → {Y : Type uY} → AuditCP.AuditChannel S A Y → Prop

leaves.doc:
The channel revealing the public state together with `K`'s output,
`fun sa => (K sa).map (fun y => (sa.1, y))`.
leaves.pretty: {S : Type uS} → {A : Type uA} → {Y : Type uY} → AuditCP.AuditChannel S A Y → AuditCP.AuditChannel S A (S × Y)

leaves.doc:
The channel revealing exactly the public state `s` and nothing else,
`fun (s, a) => PMF.pure s`.
leaves.pretty: {S : Type uS} → {A : Type uA} → AuditCP.AuditChannel S A S

nodes.doc:
F2 — given `A` nonempty,
`BlackwellEquivalent (learnerExperiment K) publicOnlyExperiment ↔ AuditSealed K` (blackwell1953).
nodes.pretty:
∀ {S : Type uS} {A : Type uA} {Y : Type uY} [Nonempty A] (K : AuditCP.AuditChannel S A Y),
  AuditCP.BlackwellEquivalent (AuditCP.learnerExperiment K) AuditCP.publicOnlyExperiment ↔ AuditCP.AuditSealed K

nodes.doc:
F2a — public information is Blackwell-below the complete learner view:
`BlackwellBelow publicOnlyExperiment (learnerExperiment K)`.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {S : Type uS} {A : Type uA} {Y : Type uY} (K : AuditCP.AuditChannel S A Y),
  AuditCP.BlackwellBelow AuditCP.publicOnlyExperiment (AuditCP.learnerExperiment K)

nodes.doc:
F2b — given `A` nonempty,
`BlackwellBelow (learnerExperiment K) publicOnlyExperiment ↔ AuditSealed K` (blackwell1953).
nodes.pretty:
∀ {S : Type uS} {A : Type uA} {Y : Type uY} [Nonempty A] (K : AuditCP.AuditChannel S A Y),
  AuditCP.BlackwellBelow (AuditCP.learnerExperiment K) AuditCP.publicOnlyExperiment ↔ AuditCP.AuditSealed K

nodes.doc: Pushing a PMF on `Y` through the tag `y ↦ (s, y)` is injective.
nodes.pretty: ∀ {S : Type uS} {Y : Type uY} (s : S), Function.Injective fun p => PMF.map (fun y => (s, y)) p

nodes.doc: F1 — given `A` nonempty, `AuditSealed K ↔ FactorsThroughPublic K`.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {S : Type uS} {A : Type uA} {Y : Type uY} [Nonempty A] (K : AuditCP.AuditChannel S A Y),
  AuditCP.AuditSealed K ↔ AuditCP.FactorsThroughPublic K
